ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment in this lab section is by permission of instructor (mwolske@illinois.edu). Students must also enroll in LIS 451AL1 (34283) lecture section to complete registration in this course. This lab section focuses on international community informatics as applied in Sao Tome, Africa. Students who have pre-arranged with instructor will travel to Sao Tome for three weeks at the end of the summer session (students traveling will be expected to pay for their airfare, approximately $2500, as well as various travel incidentals, including but not limited to passport, visa, innoculation, and food/lodging costs during transit). Other students will provide in-lab research support for those students traveling to Sao Tome. Students should refer to http://courseweb.lis.uiuc.edu/~mwolske/lis451/ for additional details. For credit hours see LIS 451AL1.
